sentences.text: Ayer Juan quería leer su libro.
sentences.english: Yesterday Juan wanted to read his book.

sentences.text: Fue a la mesa, pero el libro no estaba allí.
sentences.english: He went to the table, but the book was not there.

sentences.text: Juan buscó el libro en la cocina.
sentences.english: Juan looked for the book in the kitchen.

sentences.text: Lo buscó en la sala y en la cama.
sentences.english: He looked for it in the living room and in the bed.
"Ana, do you have my book?" Juan asked.
"No, I don't have it," said Ana.
"Well, I don't know where it is," said Juan.

sentences.text: —Voy a tu casa y vamos a buscarlo juntos —dijo Ana.
sentences.english: "I'm coming to your house and we're going to look for it together," said Ana.

sentences.text: Ana llegó a la casa de Juan.
Buscaron juntos en toda la casa.
sentences.english: They looked together all over the house.

sentences.text: Al final, Ana vio el libro.
sentences.english: In the end, Ana saw the book.

sentences.text: Estaba en el suelo, debajo de la mesa.
sentences.english: It was on the floor, under the table.

sentences.text: Juan tomó el libro y dio las gracias a Ana.
sentences.english: Juan took the book and thanked Ana.
Both of them were very happy.
